name: Healing Flame
text: You channel sunlight into life-giving flames. You gain the Natural Medicine skill feat. As long as you have access to fire, you gain the +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Treat Wounds using Nature granted by the feat, and you restore an additional ternary(gte(@actor.skills.nature.rank,4,5,ternarygte(@actor.skills.nature.rank,3,3,ternarygte(@actor.skills.nature.rank,2,2,1)))d4) healing Hit Points on a success. The additional healing increases to 2d4 if you're an expert in Nature, 3d4 if you're a master in Nature, and 5d4 if you're legendary in Nature.
